mapper.sql: select p.post_id, p.post_title, p.category_id, p.user_id, p.like_count, p.favorite_count, p.comment_count, p.status, p.create_time, p.update_time, (select c.category_name from learning_category c where c.category_id = p.category_id) as category_name, (select u.user_name from sys_user u where u.user_id = p.user_id) as user_name from learning_post p

select p.post_id, p.post_title, p.category_id, p.user_id, p.content, p.like_count, p.favorite_count, p.comment_count, p.status, p.is_featured, p.create_time, p.update_time, (select c.category_name from learning_category c where c.category_id = p.category_id) as category_name, (select u.user_name from sys_user u where u.user_id = p.user_id) as user_name from learning_post p
mapper.select: where p.user_id = #{userId} and p.del_flag = '0' and p.status = '0' order by p.create_time desc, p.post_id desc
where p.post_id = #{postId} and p.del_flag = '0' and p.status = '0'
